name: Thread
description: Draw one thread through every cell, passing the numbers in order.
hint: Drag from 1 · drag back to undo steps · click the thread to cut it · arrows · ⌘Z

howTo.goal: Draw one thread through every cell of the grid.
rules: Start at 1 and pass the numbers in order, ending on the last one.
The thread moves up, down, left or right, never crosses itself and never goes through a wall.
